alt_text: Cover: 5 rules for playing in the Cape Doctor. December, southeaster, 45 km/h.
01. Win the toss, take the wind: first half downwind, bank the goals.
02. Keep it on the floor: anything in the air ends up in Sea Point.
03. Shoot from anywhere: downwind every shot is a rocket, upwind pass it in.
04. Bring a second layer: warm at 17:00, cold at 18:30.
05. Show up anyway: wind is not an excuse. Rain is a different story.
Wind or no wind, the game's on. Free 5-a-side games in Cape Town, opening area by area. 5sfindr.com.
